name: tinywarden-agent
usage:
Usage: tinywarden-agent --version | --help | enroll --config CONFIG_PATH --token-file TOKEN_PATH | replace --config CONFIG_PATH --token-file TOKEN_PATH | run --config CONFIG_PATH
Administrative commands (sudo): install, update, check, repair, reconnect, auto-updates on|off, --uninstall [--keep-data|--purge]. Use --install-dir for a custom managed location. Monitoring runs as the service account.
notReady: Choose enroll, replace or run. Use --help for the required options.
invalidArguments: Unsupported arguments. Use --help for available options.
enrolled: Enrollment confirmed. Start the agent to send heartbeats.
replaced: Credential replacement confirmed. Restart the agent to send heartbeats.
degraded: The server is unavailable. Retrying the saved request at a slower rate.
commandFailed: Agent stopped. Check its configuration, private state and server availability.

setup.stdinHelp: read the setup code from standard input instead of prompting
setup.arguments: Use --setup-code-stdin only with install, without --setup-code-file or --adopt.
setup.pollHelp: check Fleet update requests and run scheduled automatic work when due
setup.pollArguments: Use --poll only with update, without automatic, setup, archive or removal options.

reconnect.scopeMismatch: This setup code belongs to a different server or app.
reconnect.unfinished: Reconnection is unfinished. The service will resume its saved replacement request.
reconnect.completed: Server reconnected. The agent follows its current monitoring policy.

maintenance.root: Maintenance administration requires root. Monitoring continues without root.
maintenance.arguments: Choose maintenance --poll, --job, --status, --reconcile or --action-policy with the managed --config path. Use authorization input options only with --reconcile and origin/class options only with --action-policy.
maintenance.pollHelp: check authenticated maintenance requests and dispatch the managed worker
maintenance.jobHelp: owned maintenance job identifier; managed worker use only
maintenance.statusHelp: display the saved local maintenance receipt without changing packages
maintenance.reconcileHelp: inspect the retained action's state and reconcile its scoped job; never repair or retry execution
maintenance.authorizationStdinHelp: read the one-time recovery authorization from standard input instead of a hidden prompt
maintenance.recoveryInput: Use a hidden terminal prompt or --authorization-stdin with one valid recovery authorization.
maintenance.authorizationPromptHelp: request a replacement recovery authorization through the hidden terminal prompt
maintenance.policyHelp: show the local repository/action execution policy; change it only with explicit --origin and --allow or --deny
maintenance.originHelp: verified numeric GitHub repository ID and owner ID, separated by a colon
maintenance.allowHelp: explicitly trust this repository's unprivileged or host_admin action code; package and transaction approvals are still required
maintenance.denyHelp: remove this repository's unprivileged or host_admin execution permission
